translations.web: for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn’t lay down, and reap that which you didn’t sow.’
translations.bsb: For I was afraid of you, because you are a harsh man. You withdraw what you did not deposit and reap what you did not sow.’
translations.kjv: For I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that thou layedst not down, and reapest that thou didst not sow.
